Name: Siasz's Linus Portraits
Author: Siasz
Description: Sorry for the delay, Iv been losing motivation a bit with all of these AI portraits coming out… they look a lot better and cleaner than mine so it can be disheartening, but I see people downloading mine still so I’m going to keep going! First regular villager complete! Hope you enjoy. Will be posting beach images for Abigail and Seb soon, Villager Demetrius, and Bachelor Sam.  Let me know if there is anyone people would like to see drawn!

Downloads.Description: Download the file, go into the zipped folder, copy and paste the image into the portraiture mod where your other images are, if it asks to replace any existing images, click yes.
